name: Grozdana Kakra
source: I-it’s not like she enjoys being here! She’s too proud for her own good, and recently became the deposed princess of a sphinx-girl nation. Despite having been born with a golden spoon in her mouth, she can see and feel more than she lets on… but it’s not as though she still doesn’t act like a brat...
